agent.prompt: Use Develop in this isolated fictional exercise. Use only the supplied records and existing supported output tools; do not contact providers, install anything, publish, start a schedule or change unrelated files. Explain this request path and where database failure affects the user, using flow.txt.

inputs.content: The browser sends a request to the API. The API checks the cache. A hit returns through the API to the browser. A miss reads the database, fills the cache, then returns through the API to the browser. A database error on a miss returns an error through the API; no successful cache fill occurs.
